en.title: OpenAI Chief Scientist Proposes an Industry-Wide 'Speed Limit' and Publishes Internal Perplexity Scores
en.excerpt: Jakub Pachocki argues perplexity should anchor shared safety limits, disclosing an internal curve that runs from GPT-3.5 to an unreleased model at 0.732.
en.content:
OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki published an essay titled **Perplexity and Intelligence** on November 22, arguing that the industry should adopt a common yardstick for tracking AI progress and a shared ceiling that labs agree not to cross until safety monitoring catches up.

Pachocki disclosed OpenAI's internal log-perplexity curve for the first time: GPT-3.5 sat near 0.99 and GPT-4 near 0.91 on the company's held-out codebase; losses below 0.8 coincided with transformative capabilities in cybersecurity and mathematics, and a model near 0.76 began producing groundbreaking results on open math problems. GPT-6.2 Astra sits around 0.761, while an unreleased internal model has reached about 0.732. He expects further transformative capabilities around **0.68-0.70** and warns that an avalanche of pretraining advances could arrive as soon as 2027.

The proposal is a ceiling, not a ban: frontier developers would set common limits and red-team safety cases before a model is first used. CEO Sam Altman backed the essay, calling it one of the most important things OpenAI has published in a while. Pachocki also lists the weaknesses — perplexity is hard to compare across labs, misses post-training gains such as chain-of-thought, and has an unknown floor.

zh.title: OpenAI 首席科学家提议行业共同「限速」，首度公布内部困惑度曲线
zh.excerpt: 雅库布·帕霍茨基主张以困惑度作为跨实验室的共同标尺，并首度披露从 GPT-3.5 到未公开模型 0.732 的内部曲线。
zh.content:
OpenAI 首席科学家雅库布·帕霍茨基（Jakub Pachocki）11 月 22 日发表题为《Perplexity and Intelligence》的文章，主张行业采用共同标尺追踪 AI 进展，并设定各实验室在安全监控跟上之前不越过的共同上限。

他首次披露 OpenAI 内部的对数困惑度曲线：在其留出代码库上，GPT-3.5 约为 0.99、GPT-4 约为 0.91；损失低于 0.8 时，网络安全与数学领域出现变革性能力；约 0.76 的模型开始在开放数学难题上产出突破性结果。GPT-6.2 Astra 约为 0.761，一个未公开的内部模型已达约 0.732。他预计在 **0.68-0.70** 区间会出现更多变革性能力，并警告最早 2027 年就可能出现预训练突破的雪崩。

这一提议是上限而非禁令：前沿开发者应设定共同限制，并在模型首次投入使用前完成红队安全评估。CEO 奥尔特曼公开背书，称这是 OpenAI 一段时间以来发表的最重要内容之一。帕霍茨基同时列出局限——困惑度难以跨实验室比较、无法反映思维链等后训练增益，且理论下限未知。

en.title: US BIS Rule Brings Foreign Data Centers' Remote Compute Under Export Licensing
en.excerpt: A new interim rule extends export controls from physical chips to remote compute, requiring licenses for large-scale access by firms headquartered in China and D:5 countries.
en.content:
The US Bureau of Industry and Security issued an interim final rule on November 16 that moves the export-control boundary from physical chips to **remote access to compute**. It took effect on publication in the Federal Register on November 19.

The rule adds Section 744.24 to the EAR. Overseas data centers that provide more than 12 million aggregate TPP of compute — roughly the maximum of 750 Nvidia H100 or H200 chips — to companies headquartered, or ultimately parented, in China (including Macao) or D:5 countries need a case-by-case BIS license. The threshold applies to data centers linked by physical or digital networks that can share resources, and indirect provisioning through a third country is also covered. Existing facilities have a **90-day window** to obtain a license.

The rule also adds license requirements for advanced chip exports to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil, tightens foundry and packaging presumptions, and narrows an exception for commercial recommendation systems so it excludes generative models. A 60-day public comment period follows.

zh.title: 美国 BIS 新规把海外数据中心远程算力纳入出口许可
zh.excerpt: 临时最终规则将出口管制从芯片实体延伸到远程算力，向中国及 D:5 国家企业提供大规模算力访问须逐案申请许可。
zh.content:
美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）11 月 16 日发布临时最终规则，将出口管制边界从芯片实体**延伸到远程算力访问**。该规则 11 月 19 日在《联邦公报》刊登后即时生效。

规则在《出口管理条例》中新增第 744.24 条：海外数据中心若向总部或最终母公司位于中国（含中国澳门）及 D:5 国家组的企业，提供超过 1200 万聚合 TPP 的算力（约相当于 750 颗英伟达 H100 或 H200 的最大计算能力），须逐案申请 BIS 许可。门槛同样适用于通过物理或数字网络互联、可共享资源的数据中心；经第三国间接提供算力也在审查范围内。存量数据中心有 **90 天窗口期**申请许可。

新规另对印尼、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、巴西五国增加先进芯片出口许可，收紧晶圆代工与先进封装的推定规则，并把商业推荐系统的例外收窄——不涵盖生成式模型。规则刊登后开放 60 天公众评论。

en.title: Apple Is Building a Computer-Use AI Agent to Rival OpenAI and Anthropic, Bloomberg Reports
en.excerpt: A job listing for a 'proactive agentic AI' manager points to an early-stage agent that can code, browse and control apps, with a launch eyed for late 2027.
en.content:
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported on November 19 that Apple is developing an autonomous AI agent able to write and debug code, browse the web and control apps across a device — a direct answer to agents from Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic and Google.

The evidence is a since-removed Apple job listing for a senior engineering manager in **Agentic AI — Proactive**. It describes general-purpose computer-use agents that plan and carry out multistep tasks across apps, browsers, command lines, code and APIs, and coordinate specialized subagents, with strong permission models, sandboxing and transparency said to be central. The hire would work with the Siri, UI frameworks and Apple Foundation Models teams.

Development is early and a launch was eyed as soon as late 2027, but nothing is announced. New CEO John Ternus is pressing software chief Craig Federighi to move faster. Separately, macOS 27.3 raised the steps to enable ChatGPT's computer use from four to 14; Apple cites security, while some see an anti-competitive effect.

zh.title: 苹果据报自研电脑操控 AI 智能体，最早 2027 年底推出
zh.excerpt: 一则「主动式智能体 AI」招聘信息指向可写代码、浏览网页、操控应用的早期项目，对标 OpenAI 与 Anthropic。
zh.content:
彭博社记者马克·古尔曼 11 月 19 日报道，苹果正在开发一款自主 AI 智能体，可编写与调试代码、浏览网页、跨应用操控设备，直接对标 Meta、OpenAI、Anthropic 与谷歌的智能体产品。

线索来自苹果一则随后被撤下的招聘信息，岗位为**「主动式智能体 AI」高级工程经理**。其中描述「通用电脑操控智能体」可跨应用、浏览器、命令行、代码与 API 规划并执行多步骤任务，并协调专门的子智能体；招聘信息强调严格的权限模型、沙盒隔离与操作透明度。该岗位将与 Siri、UI 框架和 Apple Foundation Models 团队合作。

项目仍处早期，曾考虑最早 2027 年底推出，但尚无公开名称、价格或确定日期。新任 CEO 约翰·特努斯正推动软件主管克雷格·费德里吉加快 AI 进度。与此同时，macOS 27.3 把开启 ChatGPT 电脑操控的步骤从 4 步增加到 14 步；苹果称出于安全，也有人认为客观抬高竞品门槛。

en.title: Amazon Nears $7.5 Billion Deal for AI Efficiency Startup Decart
en.excerpt: The FT reports talks in an advanced stage to buy the Israeli-founded startup, whose software makes AI models run more efficiently on Amazon's Trainium3 chips.
en.content:
The Financial Times reported on November 21-22 that Amazon is in late-stage talks to acquire AI startup Decart for about **$7.5 billion**, a deal that could close as early as next week, though negotiations could still break down.

Decart was founded in 2023 by three Israeli engineers and is headquartered in San Francisco. In May it raised $300 million at a valuation near $4 billion, with investors including Radical Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Benchmark and Nvidia. Its software improves how efficiently models run, freeing chip capacity — a key bottleneck as tech firms spend hundreds of billions on compute.

Decart is an early adopter of Amazon's Trainium3 chip, making it a software complement to AWS's in-house silicon. It also makes Lucy, which edits video in real time, and Oasis, which generates interactive worlds. Anthropic explored a roughly $6 billion acquisition in August and walked away in September; Nvidia had also considered a deal.

zh.title: 亚马逊接近以 75 亿美元收购 AI 效率初创公司 Decart
zh.excerpt: 英国《金融时报》称谈判进入后期，标的公司软件可提升模型运行效率，并已采用亚马逊 Trainium3 芯片。
zh.content:
英国《金融时报》11 月 21 至 22 日报道，亚马逊正就约 **75 亿美元**收购 AI 初创公司 Decart 进行后期谈判，交易最快下周达成，但仍存在破裂可能。

Decart 由三名以色列工程师于 2023 年创立，总部位于旧金山。今年 5 月，该公司以接近 40 亿美元估值完成 3 亿美元融资，投资方包括 Radical Ventures、红杉资本、Benchmark 和英伟达。其核心软件能提升 AI 模型运行效率、释放芯片算力——在科技公司投入数千亿美元抢算力的背景下，这是关键瓶颈。

Decart 是亚马逊 Trainium3 芯片的早期采用者，其技术与 AWS 自研芯片形成软硬互补。公司还开发了可实时编辑视频的 Lucy 与生成交互式虚拟世界的 Oasis。Anthropic 曾在 8 月洽谈约 60 亿美元收购，9 月退出；英伟达也曾考虑出手。

en.title: Apollo and Goldman Arrange Record $44 Billion GPU Lease Financing for SpaceX
en.excerpt: Reuters reports the largest GPU lease financing ever, using an ABS structure to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chips for SpaceX's ground-based compute buildout.
en.content:
Reuters reported on November 22 that Apollo Global Management and Goldman Sachs arranged roughly **$44 billion** in debt financing for SpaceX to acquire Nvidia GPUs and related equipment — described by the firms as the largest GPU lease financing ever. Oversubscribed demand forced the deal size up.

Details include $25.17 billion of senior secured A3 notes due April 2033 at a yield of 8.259%. Proceeds are expected to fund deployment of Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin chips for SpaceX's ground-based AI compute; the lease begins when equipment is delivered in the first half of 2027. BlackRock, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and KKR participated, with Pimco buying about $4 billion.

The structure blends asset-backed securitization with corporate-bond features — a five-year triple-net, "hell-or-high-water" finance lease. Bloomberg reported that some lenders worry the collateralized chips could end up in SpaceX's planned orbital data centers, making them hard to reclaim. SpaceX says the chips will be deployed only on Earth.

zh.title: 阿波罗与高盛为 SpaceX 安排约 440 亿美元史上最大 GPU 租赁融资
zh.excerpt: 路透社报道，这笔以资产证券化结构支持的交易将为 SpaceX 部署英伟达 Vera Rubin 芯片提供资金。
zh.content:
路透社 11 月 22 日报道，阿波罗全球管理公司与高盛集团为 SpaceX 收购英伟达 GPU 及相关设备安排了约 **440 亿美元**债务融资，两家公司称这是有史以来最大规模的 GPU 租赁融资。投资者需求超过供应，推动交易规模扩大。

细节包括价值 251.7 亿美元、2033 年 4 月到期、收益率 8.259% 的高级担保 A3 票据。资金预计用于部署英伟达下一代 Vera Rubin 芯片、扩展 SpaceX 地面 AI 算力，租赁计划将在 2027 年上半年设备交付时开始。贝莱德、高盛资产管理与 KKR 参与投资，Pimco 买入约 40 亿美元证券。

该结构结合资产证券化与公司债特征，是一份五年期三净、无条件支付的融资租赁。彭博社报道称，部分贷款方担心作为抵押品的芯片可能被用于 SpaceX 规划的轨道数据中心，导致违约时难以收回；SpaceX 表示芯片只会部署在地面。

en.title: Google Swaps the Search Button for Gemini Shortcuts on Its Desktop Homepage
en.excerpt: A global, gradual rollout adds a collapsible AI chat sidebar and replaces the iconic search button with Gemini-powered shortcuts.
en.content:
Google began a global, gradual rollout on November 19 of a redesigned desktop homepage that puts Gemini front and center. Search VP Robby Stein confirmed the change on X, saying a new collapsible left sidebar surfaces recent AI Mode conversations, a new-thread button and a Notebooks section.

The bigger change sits under the search box: the classic **Google Search button is replaced** by Gemini-powered shortcuts for creating images with Nano Banana, analyzing uploaded files and brainstorming. The Google logo, search box and "I'm Feeling Lucky" button remain; pressing Enter still returns regular results, and traditional search is not being removed.

Stein said users increasingly arrive with questions that are not "one and done," and testing showed the sidebar helped them resume threads. AI Mode passed one billion monthly users in May. No mobile rollout was announced. Some commentators read the prominence of AI features and thesidebar's permanence as a sign that AI Mode may one day become the default.

zh.title: 谷歌桌面搜索首页取消搜索按钮，换成 Gemini 快捷入口与侧边栏
zh.excerpt: 全球渐进推送的新版首页加入可折叠 AI 对话侧边栏，沿用二十多年的「Google 搜索」按钮被 Gemini 快捷入口取代。
zh.content:
谷歌 11 月 19 日开始全球渐进推送重新设计的桌面首页，把 Gemini 放到最显眼位置。搜索副总裁罗比·斯坦（Robby Stein）在 X 上证实，新的左侧可折叠侧边栏可查看近期 AI Mode 对话、新建对话快捷键与 Notebooks 入口。

更大的变化在搜索框下方：沿用二十多年的**「Google 搜索」按钮被 Gemini 快捷入口取代**，包括用 Nano Banana 生成图片、上传并分析文件、与 Gemini「头脑风暴」。谷歌标识、搜索框与「手气不错」按钮保留；按回车仍返回常规结果，传统搜索并未取消。

斯坦表示，用户带着「不只问一次」的问题而来，测试显示侧边栏有助于续接对话。AI Mode 今年 5 月月活已突破 10 亿。目前未宣布移动端计划。有评论认为，AI 功能获得醒目入口、对话侧栏长期驻留，反映传统搜索被淡化，AI Mode 未来或成默认。

en.title: Apple Open-Sources Depth Pro 2 for Metric Depth in Photos and Video
en.excerpt: Four models estimate a distance in meters for every pixel at full resolution, extending Apple's depth work from stills to video.
en.content:
Apple published Depth Pro 2 on November 19, releasing weights on Hugging Face, code on GitHub and a technical report on arXiv. It is a monocular metric-depth system: from a single ordinary camera, it estimates a distance in meters for every pixel at the input's full resolution, without stereo pairs or lidar.

The release includes four sizes — S (24M parameters, 97 MB), B (97M), L (334M) and the default H+ (872M, 3.5 GB) — plus a shared 23.5M-parameter focal-length estimator that converts pixels into meters when camera metadata is missing. An architecture of a multi-view transformer with alternating within-frame and cross-frame attention, followed by a DPT decoder, targets sharp boundaries and temporally stable video depth.

Apple reports Depth Pro 2 beats prior single- and multi-frame methods on Boundary F1 and jitter across Sintel and Spring; on Sintel, H+ reaches 41.4% delta-1 versus 37.0% for UniDepthV2-L. The weights are licensed for non-commercial research and academic development only.

zh.title: 苹果开源 Depth Pro 2：普通照片视频逐像素估算以米为单位的深度
zh.excerpt: 四个模型在原始分辨率下输出逐像素度量深度，把苹果的深度估计从单图扩展到视频。
zh.content:
苹果 11 月 19 日发布 Depth Pro 2，在 Hugging Face 放出权重、在 GitHub 放出代码，并发表 arXiv 技术报告。这是一套单目度量深度系统：仅用一台普通相机，就能在输入原始分辨率下为每个像素估算以米为单位的距离，无需双目配对或激光雷达。

发布包含四种尺寸——S（2400 万参数、97 MB）、B（9700 万）、L（3.34 亿）与默认的 H+（8.72 亿、3.5 GB），另有一个共用的 2350 万参数焦距估计器，在缺少相机元数据时把像素换算成米。其架构为多视图 Transformer（帧内与跨帧注意力交替）加 DPT 解码器，目标是锐利边界与稳定的视频深度。

苹果称在 Sintel 与 Spring 数据集上，Depth Pro 2 的 Boundary F1 与抖动指标优于以往单帧与多帧方法；在 Sintel 上 H+ 的 δ1 为 41.4%，高于 UniDepthV2-L 的 37.0%。权重仅授权用于非商业科研与学术开发。

en.title: Gait Foundation Model Predicts 1,887 Health Traits from 3D Motion, Nature Medicine Reports
en.excerpt: A model trained on 3D skeletal motion from 3,328 adults linked walking patterns to liver stiffness, sleep and diabetes beyond age and body composition.
en.content:
A study published in Nature Medicine reports a gait foundation model that learns representations from 3D skeletal motion and predicts a wide range of health traits. Researchers at the Weizmann Institute of Science recorded 3,328 adults performing five movement tasks, tracked 26 joints with a depth camera, and trained the model by hiding parts of the motion and asking it to reconstruct them.

After correcting for multiple testing, gait embeddings significantly predicted **1,887 of 3,210 phenotypes**. Correlations were roughly 0.69 for age, 0.90-0.92 for BMI and about 0.82 for visceral fat area. Adding gait information to models already containing age, BMI, visceral fat and height improved predictions in all 18 body systems in men and 17 of 18 in women. Movement patterns predicted liver stiffness about as well as blood tests, and torso motion carried signals tied to sleep and exercise.

The authors caution the study is cross-sectional, so it does not establish causation; participants were mostly healthy Ashkenazi Jewish adults in Israel, and the depth-camera maker Newton Tech co-authored the paper. Independent clinical validation is still needed.

zh.title: Nature Medicine 步态基础模型：从三维骨骼运动预测 1887 项健康特征
zh.excerpt: 基于 3328 名成人的三维动作训练，模型在年龄、体成分之外还能预测肝脏硬度、睡眠与糖尿病相关指标。
zh.content:
《自然·医学》发表的一项研究提出步态基础模型，从三维骨骼运动中学习表征并预测广泛的健康特征。魏茨曼科学研究所的研究者记录了 3328 名成人完成五项动作任务，用深度相机追踪 26 个关节，并通过遮蔽部分动作、要求模型重建的方式训练。

在校正多重检验后，步态嵌入与 **3210 项健康特征中的 1887 项**显著相关：与年龄的相关系数约 0.69、BMI 约 0.90-0.92、内脏脂肪面积约 0.82。在已包含年龄、BMI、内脏脂肪与身高的模型上加入步态信息后，男性 18 个身体系统全部、女性 18 个中的 17 个预测得到改善。运动模式对肝脏硬度的预测与血液检测相当，躯干运动则携带与睡眠和锻炼相关的信号。

作者提醒，该研究为横断面研究，不能确立因果关系；参与者多为以色列健康的德系犹太成人，且深度相机制造商 Newton Tech 为论文共同作者。该模型仍需独立临床验证。

en.title: GPT-6.2 Astra Doubles Robot Task Success on XDOF's Ember-0 Benchmark
en.excerpt: A dual-arm robot's average success across 16 manipulation tasks rose from 19.6% to 41.2%, solving knot-tying and T-shirt unfolding for the first time.
en.content:
Robotics infrastructure company XDOF reports that GPT-6.2 Astra reached a **41.2% average success rate** across 16 manipulation tasks on its Ember-0 benchmark, up from 19.6% for GPT-6 Astra two months earlier — a gain of 21.6 percentage points.

Ember-0 runs a dual-arm robot in real physical environments, covering grasping, spatial reasoning, two-arm coordination, tool use and deformable objects. XDOF ran trials in parallel on six YAM workstations with 30 repetitions per task and human annotation of substeps, grasp failures and collisions. The model completed knot-tying and T-shirt unfolding — tasks no model had solved before, with 143 prior valid unfolding trials ending in failure. Picking up bread with tongs jumped from 10% to 90%. Average prediction latency fell from 15 seconds to 10.1 seconds.

OpenAI developer accounts reposted the results and Greg Brockman praised the model's robotics performance. The limits remain real: a 41.2% average means most attempts still fail, and roughly 10 seconds of latency is too slow for continuous control. XDOF says Ember-0 may soon saturate.

zh.title: GPT-6.2 Astra 具身实测：双臂机器人 16 项任务成功率由 19.6% 翻倍至 41.2%
zh.excerpt: XDOF 的 Ember-0 基准显示，模型首次完成打结与展开 T 恤，平均预测延迟从 15 秒降至 10.1 秒。
zh.content:
机器人基础设施公司 XDOF 报告，GPT-6.2 Astra 在其 Ember-0 基准的 16 项操作任务上平均成功率达到 **41.2%**，高于两个月前 GPT-6 Astra 的 19.6%，提升 21.6 个百分点。

Ember-0 在真实物理环境中操控双臂机器人，覆盖抓取、空间推理、双臂协同、工具使用与可变形物体。XDOF 在 6 个 YAM 工作站并行测试，每项任务重复 30 次，并由人工标注子步骤、抓取失败与碰撞。模型完成了打结与展开 T 恤——此前没有任何模型通过这两项，展开 T 恤已有 143 次有效试验全部失败；用夹子夹面包的成功率从 10% 跃升至 90%。平均预测延迟从 15 秒降至 10.1 秒。

OpenAI 开发者账号转发了结果，联合创始人布罗克曼称模型在机器人上表现出色。局限同样明显：41.2% 的均值意味着多数尝试仍失败，约 10 秒延迟对连续控制仍偏慢。XDOF 表示 Ember-0 基准可能很快被模型能力饱和。

en.title: alphaXiv Launches a Preprint Server for AI Agents as 936 Agents Publish 936 Papers
en.excerpt: A 12-week experiment let nearly a thousand autonomous agents research, review and cite one another, forming an early scientific community.
en.content:
alphaXiv launched a preprint server built specifically for AI agents and published a 12-week observational study, A Society of AI Scientists, on November 19; Science covered the experiment the same day.

Across the experiment, 35 human-run labs released 936 autonomous agents that produced 936 studies with code and data, exchanged 9,500 messages in 229 agent-created chat rooms, and formed topical hubs. Because negative results counted as much as positive ones, agents cited failed experiments about as often as successful ones and retracted mistaken claims before posting. One lab founded the **Journal of Agent Research**, with agents serving as editors and reviewers.

Blinded comparisons rated agent papers above recent human preprints on experimental rigor and measured claims, but below them on novelty and significance. Some participants called much of the output incremental. Organizers say converting reviewer objections into executable scripts and rerunning them exposed hidden flaws that text-only review missed. Compute costs exceeded hundreds of thousands of dollars, and the setup is seen as a better fit for machine learning than wet-lab sciences.

zh.title: alphaXiv 上线 AI 智能体专属预印本服务器：936 个 Agent 12 周产出 936 篇论文
zh.excerpt: 一场为期 12 周的实验让近千个自主智能体研究、互评与引用，浮现出早期科学共同体雏形。
zh.content:
alphaXiv 上线了专门面向 AI 智能体的预印本服务器，并于 11 月 19 日公开 12 周观察研究《一个 AI 科学家社群》，《科学》杂志同日报道了该实验。

实验中，35 个人类运营的实验室投放了 936 个自主智能体，共产出 936 项研究及配套代码与数据，在 229 个由智能体创建的聊天室交换约 9500 条消息，并形成主题交流中心。由于负面结果与正面结果同等计分，智能体引用失败实验与成功实验的频率相当，并会在发表前主动撤回错误主张。一个实验室还创办了**《智能体研究期刊》**，由智能体担任编辑与审稿人。

盲评显示，智能体论文在实验严谨性与主张衡量上高于近期人类预印本，但在新颖性与重要性上仍逊色，部分参与者称大量成果只是渐进式增量。组织者表示，把审稿质疑转化为可执行脚本重跑，暴露出只读文本难以发现的隐藏缺陷。项目算力成本已超数十万美元，被认为更适合机器学习，而非依赖湿实验的学科。

en.title: Meta Reconsiders 2030 Net-Zero Goal as AI-Driven Emissions Jump 45%
en.excerpt: Its 2026 sustainability report shows 2025 emissions up 45% to 11.8 million tonnes, far above peers, putting the climate deadline under review.
en.content:
Meta's 2026 sustainability report, released November 19, shows net emissions rose **45% in 2025** to about 11.8 million tonnes of CO2 equivalent, while electricity use climbed about 35%. Executives say they are re-evaluating the 2030 net-zero goal set in 2020, reviewing "timelines, sequencing and interim milestones."

The emissions increase far exceeds peers cited by Axios — Google at 18%, Amazon at 16% and Microsoft at 25%. Data-center VP Rachel Peterson and net-zero head Blair Swedeen wrote that when the goal was set they anticipated steady growth and falling clean-energy costs, but "the reality has been far more complex." Meta says it has contracted more than 30 gigawatts of clean energy, though less than half is generating.

The report notes Meta may turn to natural gas plants where utilities cannot deliver power fast enough. In Louisiana, Entergy is pursuing seven gas units above 5,200 MW to serve Meta's data centers. Direct water use fell 4%, but use in water-stressed regions rose 24% and electricity-related water use rose 37%.

zh.title: Meta 因 AI 基建排放激增 45%，重新评估 2030 净零目标
zh.excerpt: 2026 可持续发展报告显示 2025 年净排放升至约 1180 万吨，远高于同行，2030 气候期限进入重审。
zh.content:
Meta 11 月 19 日发布的 2026 可持续发展报告显示，2025 年净排放**上升 45%**至约 1180 万吨二氧化碳当量，用电量增长约 35%。高管表示正在重新评估 2020 年设定的 2030 净零目标，审视「时间线、排序与中期里程碑」。

这一增幅远高于 Axios 引用的同行——谷歌 18%、亚马逊 16%、微软 25%。数据中心副总裁雷切尔·彼得森与净零主管布莱尔·斯威登写道，设定目标时预期稳定增长与清洁能源成本下降，但「现实远为复杂」。Meta 称已签约超过 30 吉瓦清洁能源，但不到一半已发电。

报告指出，当公用事业无法足够快供电时，Meta 可能转向天然气电厂。在路易斯安那州，Entergy 正推进七台总计超过 5200 兆瓦的燃气机组服务 Meta 数据中心。直接用水下降 4%，但高水压力地区用水上升 24%、发电相关用水上升 37%。
